currentRoundInspection.scope: Three useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected older close front: light coursed stone basilica, triangular front gable and round rose, large gabled round-arched open porch with wood door behind it, white pilasters/corbels, broad front steps, one then-complete square multi-tier campanile with round openings, clock, paired top arches and shallow cap/cross. Tree cover hides some lower facade.

Inspected August2025 front: both square towers are present with open tiers and paired top arches, shallow caps and crosses. Left-of-front tower has visible clock hands; right tower has a blank circular field. Front rose/porch and off-white horizontal masonry agree with close view. Do not freeze the earlier one-tower construction state or add temporary street work/scaffolding.

Inspected September2020 oblique side: red ceramic pitched upper nave and lower lean-to aisle roof, long rhythm of paired round-headed clerestory windows with pale pilasters, low side round windows, repeated tower cornices, single round stage openings, clock and paired upper openings/rail balcony. Only one tower then complete. Rear apse and lower mapped platform retain map-led approximate forms; their full facades are not independently photographed here.
